description: This file contains unit tests for the Validator component of the OrangeHRM API V2. It defines tests for validating input data against predefined rules, including various data types and optional parameters. The class ValidatorTest extends a base TestCase and includes data providers for multiple test scenarios.

classes.description: Unit test class for validating API input rules within the OrangeHRM system.
